notes: Stage 1 varies only the window; all else at defaults (hidden 64, 1 layer, dropout 0.1, lr 1e-3). Best of stage 1 (RMSE 171.2), but only ~2 MAE below window 288. Fixed at 36: also cheapest (12 s vs 87 s for 288).
Within ~1 MAE of window 36. No gain from a longer context.

RMSE 171.3, same as window 36, even though ACF showed strong lag-144 correlation (0.88). Hypothesis (untested): the time-of-day/day-of-week inputs already supply the daily phase. Early stop at epoch 13/21.
Slowest (87 s) and worst RMSE (174.0) of stage 1. No benefit from two days of context.
Under-capacity: MAE 116.7, clearly worse than hidden 64. Testing wider next.

Identical to the stage-1 window-36 run (109.24), which confirms the fixed-seed setup is reproducible.
MAE 108.9 vs 109.2 for 1 layer: a 0.3 difference is not meaningful with single-seed noise.

Much worse (118.6) and stopped early (best epoch 14/22). Depth did not help; because hidden 64 with 2 layers behaved differently, part of this may be seed noise.
Best epoch 10/18 and worst of the lr 3e-3 runs (112.4): no dropout at a high lr overfits or is unstable.

Dropout 0.3 is too strong: 105.1, stopped at epoch 10/18.
No dropout: 103.7, slightly worse than dropout 0.1 (102.2).

Slow convergence (best epoch 44/52) and worse result (107.7): lr too low for the epoch budget.
112.0: low lr did not help.
Worst LSTM run (121.7): low lr plus heavy dropout most likely underfits.

Best of stage 1 (RMSE 161.1). Fixed at 72.
104.2: no better than 72, so a full day of history adds nothing here.
103.9, within 0.4 MAE of window 72 but the slowest run (144 s). Windows 72-288 are indistinguishable, so I kept the cheapest.
Too small (5,857 parameters): 118.4, worst of the grid.
116.8: still under-capacity.
109.1: with 16 channels more depth helped, but still behind 32 channels.
104.3, close to the 5-level result.
Stage-1 winner reproduced exactly (103.52).
108.5, best epoch only 4/12. Hypothesis: with 6 levels the receptive field (253) far exceeds the 72-step window and training becomes unstable. Untested.
109.2, best epoch 4/12: early stop after 4 epochs, another sign of unstable training.
Best of stage 2 (MAE 100.8, RMSE 157.6). Largest network that trained stably. Fixed for stage 3.
112.0, best epoch 4/12 again. 6 levels stopped after 4 epochs at both 32 and 64 channels, so the depth is the likely problem.

111.6: too much dropout.
